title: Italian-Style Stir Fry with Celery
description: A comforting and flavorful Italian-inspired stir fry recipe featuring crunchy celery, savory sauce, and a hint of Italian seasonings.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add celery and onion and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add Italian seasoning and stir to combine.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in parmesan cheese and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
